questions.question: When was apixaban first recorded, and at what dose and frequency was it originally prescribed?
Is there documentation of the prescriber's confirmation of the apixaban dose (2.5 mg vs 5 mg)?
What was the indication for starting apixaban, and when was it documented?
Have renal function or other labs affecting apixaban dosing (e.g., creatinine, eGFR, weight, age) been recorded?
Are there recorded bleeding events, falls or other adverse effects since apixaban was started?
Has anticoagulation monitoring or a medication review been planned or completed for apixaban?
